description: Carry out a plan from create_wordpress_task on the WordPress site (or its test copy, if the plan was made for it). Tell the user the planned steps and ask before calling this. It stops at the first failing step; what ran before stays done — tell the user what was done and what was not. Can take longer than a minute.

task_id.description: The task's id from the tool that created it.

name: run_wordpress_task
title: Run a WordPress task
